changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.comment: Full schema from docs/notification-service-schema-design.md, isolated from the existing notifications schema. No application flow changes or catalog/provider/template seeds. Schema DDL, CHECK constraints and grants use SQL because Liquibase Community has no equivalent native changes.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Notification definition ID.

column.name: source_service
column.remarks: Authenticated caller identity, assigned by the service rather than trusted from arbitrary input.

column.name: idempotency_key
column.remarks: Caller-supplied submission key. UQ with source_service.

column.name: request_hash
column.remarks: Hash of canonical original submission; reject reuse of a key with different content.

column.name: correlation_id
column.remarks: Links related notifications to an upstream business event.

column.name: notification_type_id
column.remarks: FK to notification_types.id; update, promotion, alert, event, or security.

column.name: mode_id
column.remarks: FK to notification_modes.id; email, SMS, or in-app.

column.name: template_id
column.remarks: Part of composite FK to notification_templates(id, version).

column.name: template_version
column.remarks: Positive pinned version; do not resolve “latest” when sending.

column.name: message_details
column.remarks: Template variables; validate against the template's input schema.

column.name: priority
column.remarks: Bounded priority, for example 0–100; higher values run first among due deliveries.

column.name: schedule_kind
column.remarks: immediate, once, or cron.

column.name: scheduled_at
column.remarks: Required for once; absent for immediate and cron.

column.name: cron_expression
column.remarks: Required only for cron; validated five-field minute/hour/day/month/weekday expression.

column.name: timezone
column.remarks: Valid IANA timezone for cron evaluation; default UTC.

column.name: starts_at
column.remarks: Inclusive lower bound for recurring occurrences.

column.name: ends_at
column.remarks: Exclusive upper bound for recurring occurrences.

column.name: next_run_at
column.remarks: Indexed scheduler cursor; null when no occurrence remains to be created.

column.name: misfire_policy
column.remarks: skip or fire_once; defines what happens to overdue occurrences after downtime.

column.name: delivery_ttl_seconds
column.remarks: Positive lifetime measured from each occurrence's original scheduled time.

column.name: status
column.remarks: active, paused, completed, or cancelled; describes scheduling, not delivery success.

column.name: revision
column.remarks: Positive counter, starts at 1; increment on content, target, schedule, or policy changes.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation time; default now().

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last definition change; application or trigger maintains it.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Creating user or service principal.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: Last modifying user or service principal.

column.name: deleted_at
column.remarks: Soft deletion time; must stop scheduling.

column.name: notification_id
column.remarks: FK to notifications.id; part of composite PK.

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Upstream user ID; remaining part of composite PK.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Time this target was added.

column.name: notification_id
column.remarks: FK to notifications.id; part of composite PK.

column.name: segment_id
column.remarks: FK to segments.id; remaining part of composite PK.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Time this segment was added.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Occurrence ID.

column.name: notification_id
column.remarks: FK to notifications.id.

column.name: revision
column.remarks: Definition revision copied when the occurrence is created.

column.name: scheduled_at
column.remarks: Original occurrence time; never overwritten by retries or quiet hours.

column.name: expires_at
column.remarks: scheduled_at + delivery_ttl_seconds, if a TTL is configured.

column.name: template_id
column.remarks: Part of composite FK to the pinned template row.

column.name: template_version
column.remarks: Immutable template version for this occurrence.

column.name: definition_snapshot
column.remarks: Frozen category, channel, payload, priority, selected targets, and effective delivery policy.

column.name: status
column.remarks: pending, expanding, ready, failed, or cancelled; audience-expansion state only.

column.name: audience_resolved_at
column.remarks: Time recipient membership was snapshotted.

column.name: expansion_available_at
column.remarks: Next time audience expansion may run; initially the creation time.

column.name: expansion_attempt_count
column.remarks: Nonnegative expansion attempt counter for bounded retries.

column.name: lease_token
column.remarks: Ownership token for the current expansion claim.

column.name: lease_expires_at
column.remarks: Allows recovery if the audience-expansion worker stops.

column.name: last_error_code
column.remarks: Sanitized reason for the latest expansion failure.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Occurrence creation time.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last expansion-state change.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK; stable provider idempotency key where supported.

column.name: event_id
column.remarks: FK to notification_events.id; required for recurring delivery history.

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Recipient's upstream user ID.

column.name: notification_type_id
column.remarks: Category copied from the frozen event for routing and queue filtering.

column.name: mode_id
column.remarks: Channel copied from the frozen event.

column.name: provider_id
column.remarks: FK to a configured provider; resolved during expansion.

column.name: destination_snapshot
column.remarks: Protected email address, E.164 phone number, or in-app recipient address resolved from the user directory.

column.name: message_details_snapshot
column.remarks: Final variables including any recipient-specific personalization.

column.name: policy_snapshot
column.remarks: Effective retry limit, backoff limits, and any authorized quiet-hour bypass.

column.name: priority
column.remarks: Frozen queue priority.

column.name: status
column.remarks: pending, processing, retrying, accepted, delivered, failed, dead_lettered, suppressed, expired, or cancelled.

column.name: eligible_at
column.remarks: Earliest allowed send time after applying quiet hours; initially the occurrence time.

column.name: available_at
column.remarks: Next claim time including quiet hours, retries, and provider throttling.

column.name: attempt_count
column.remarks: Nonnegative number of provider attempts started.

column.name: lease_token
column.remarks: Fresh ownership token for each worker claim.

column.name: lease_expires_at
column.remarks: Time an abandoned processing claim becomes recoverable.

column.name: provider_message_id
column.remarks: Latest accepted provider message identifier, when supplied.

column.name: accepted_at
column.remarks: Provider accepted the message; this does not prove recipient delivery.

column.name: delivered_at
column.remarks: Confirmed delivery time, if the provider supports receipts.

column.name: last_error_code
column.remarks: Machine-readable failure, suppression, or deferral reason.

column.name: last_error_message
column.remarks: Short sanitized diagnostic without credentials or sensitive message content.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Recipient delivery creation time.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last delivery-state change.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Attempt ID.

column.name: delivery_id
column.remarks: FK to notification_deliveries.id.

column.name: attempt_number
column.remarks: Positive sequence number; UQ with delivery_id.

column.name: provider_id
column.remarks: FK to provider used for this attempt.

column.name: lease_token
column.remarks: Claim token responsible for the attempt.

column.name: status
column.remarks: started, accepted, transient_failure, permanent_failure, or unknown.

column.name: provider_message_id
column.remarks: Provider identifier returned for this specific attempt.

column.name: error_code
column.remarks: Normalized error code for retry classification.

column.name: error_message
column.remarks: Sanitized diagnostic.

column.name: retry_after_at
column.remarks: Provider-requested retry time when available.

column.name: started_at
column.remarks: Call start time.

column.name: finished_at
column.remarks: Completion time; null while running or until reconciled.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Logical template ID; part of composite PK.

column.name: version
column.remarks: Positive version; remaining part of composite PK.

column.name: name
column.remarks: Human-readable template name.

column.name: mode_id
column.remarks: FK to notification_modes; an enforced channel, replacing advisory ideal_mode.

column.name: ideal_type_id
column.remarks: FK to notification_types; optional suggested category, not a routing rule.

column.name: details
column.remarks: Channel-specific template content: subject/text/HTML for email, text for SMS, feed payload for in-app.

column.name: variable_schema
column.remarks: Validation schema for required and optional message variables.

column.name: comment
column.remarks: Purpose, usage notes, or version change explanation.

column.name: locale
column.remarks: Locale such as en; baseline notifications pin one locale.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Version publication time.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Publishing user or service principal.

column.name: retired_at
column.remarks: Prevents new definitions from selecting this version; existing references remain valid.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Stable category ID.

column.name: code
column.remarks: UQ: update, promotion, alert, event, or security.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable meaning and intended use.

column.name: default_opt_in
column.remarks: Product-defined default when a user has no explicit preference.

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether new requests may use this category.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Stable channel ID.

column.name: code
column.remarks: UQ: sms, email, or in_app.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Meaning of the channel.

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether the channel accepts new work.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Provider configuration ID.

column.name: code
column.remarks: UQ internal name, such as primary_email.

column.name: mode_id
column.remarks: FK to supported delivery channel.

column.name: adapter_key
column.remarks: Registered adapter implementation, such as smtp or in_app_http.

column.name: config
column.remarks: Non-secret settings, such as endpoint, sender identity, and timeout.

column.name: credentials_ref
column.remarks: Secret-manager reference; never store plaintext credentials here.

column.name: requests_per_second
column.remarks: Positive provider/account rate limit enforced across workers.

column.name: max_concurrency
column.remarks: Positive limit on simultaneous provider calls.

column.name: enabled
column.remarks: Whether workers may start new sends through this provider.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation time.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last configuration change.

column.name: notification_type_id
column.remarks: FK to category; part of composite PK.

column.name: mode_id
column.remarks: FK to channel; remaining part of composite PK.

column.name: provider_id
column.remarks: FK to provider supporting the same channel.

column.name: max_attempts
column.remarks: Positive maximum number of provider attempts per delivery.

column.name: retry_initial_seconds
column.remarks: Positive initial retry delay.

column.name: retry_max_seconds
column.remarks: Maximum backoff delay, at least the initial delay.

column.name: enabled
column.remarks: Whether new deliveries may select this route.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last routing-policy change.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Segment ID.

column.name: name
column.remarks: UQ within the application or tenant.

column.name: details
column.remarks: Description of who belongs to the segment.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation time.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last metadata or membership change.

column.name: deleted_at
column.remarks: Disables future audience resolution without deleting delivery history.

column.name: segment_id
column.remarks: FK to segments.id; part of composite PK.

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Upstream user ID; remaining part of composite PK.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Membership creation time.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Preference ID.

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Required user identity; missing from the original proposal.

column.name: notification_type_id
column.remarks: FK to category.

column.name: mode_id
column.remarks: FK to channel.

column.name: opt_in
column.remarks: Explicit allow or deny for this category/channel.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation time.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last preference change.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Quiet-hour rule ID.

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: User to whom this rule applies.

column.name: mode_id
column.remarks: FK to channel; permits email and in-app to behave differently.

column.name: enabled
column.remarks: Whether the quiet window applies.

column.name: timezone
column.remarks: Valid IANA timezone used to interpret local times.

column.name: start_time
column.remarks: Local quiet-window start, inclusive.

column.name: end_time
column.remarks: Local quiet-window end, exclusive.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation time.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last timing-policy change.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Suppression record ID.

column.name: mode_id
column.remarks: FK to channel.

column.name: destination_hash
column.remarks: Keyed hash of the normalized destination; avoids storing its plaintext here.

column.name: reason
column.remarks: Such as invalid_destination, hard_bounce, or complaint.

column.name: source
column.remarks: Provider callback, administrator, or automated validation.

column.name: expires_at
column.remarks: Optional suppression expiry; null means indefinite.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation time.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last change.

column.name: id
column.remarks: PK. Locally stored receipt ID.

column.name: provider_id
column.remarks: FK to provider.

column.name: provider_event_id
column.remarks: Stable provider event ID or adapter-generated deduplication key.

column.name: provider_message_id
column.remarks: Provider message identifier used to match an attempt.

column.name: delivery_id
column.remarks: Matched delivery; nullable when a callback arrives before the send result is stored.

column.name: event_type
column.remarks: Normalized event such as delivered, bounced, or complaint.

column.name: payload
column.remarks: Minimal sanitized receipt metadata.

column.name: occurred_at
column.remarks: Provider event time, if supplied.

column.name: received_at
column.remarks: Local receipt time.

column.name: processed_at
column.remarks: Null until reconciliation succeeds.

changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.comment: Row-local invariants from the design. Priority uses the documented 0-100 range. Cross-row scheduling/target rules, snapshot matching, immutable content, cron/timezone validation and revision increments remain responsibilities of the future service transactions; this migration does not add workers or triggers.

append.value: WHERE status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL

changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA notifications_v2 TO ${app_user}; GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA notifications_v2 TO ${app_user};

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA notifications_v2 FROM ${app_user}; REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA notifications_v2 FROM ${app_user};

changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.comment: Direct email targets for invitees without user accounts. The producer must validate and normalize email addresses and allow these targets only for email definitions.

column.name: notification_id
column.remarks: FK to notifications.id; part of composite PK.

column.name: email
column.remarks: Validated, normalized recipient email address; remaining part of composite PK.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Time this target was added.

changeSet.sql: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON notifications_v2.notification_target_emails TO ${app_user};

changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.comment: Topic catalog: each topic belongs to one notification type. Topic links on definitions, deliveries and preferences, and catalog seed data are separate changes.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Stable topic ID.

column.name: notification_type_id
column.remarks: Parent notification type; many topics belong to one type.

column.name: code
column.remarks: Unique topic code, such as document_invitation or comment_mention.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable meaning and intended use.

column.name: default_opt_in
column.remarks: Explicitly configured topic default for future topic-level preference evaluation.

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether new requests may use this topic.

changeSet.sql: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON notifications_v2.notification_topics TO ${app_user};
